entry.title: Refunct v1.5.0a0
entry.content:
This is a mod-only update with map editing fixes, apworld and yaml are the same as 1.5.0. ## 1.5.0 -> 1.5.0a - Fixed game crashes when editing a map and collecting cubes - Hide "edit-menu" when "playing" a custom map
# 1.5.0 Refunct now uses Rulebuilder! You will need at least Archipelago 0.6.7 from now on. # Custom maps in Archipelago! - You can now play custom maps and they'll give checks in Archipelago. Every button is a check for a total of 37 checks. Enable the Custom Minigame in your yaml. - You can use any custom map you want! Here's my recommended list (currently only 2 maps): [link to archipelago discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1273001824919617577/1540723304296353824). - Here's how to install them: download the maps you want. Then open Refunct and the mod. Press CTRL+SHIFT+M and select "Open Maps Folder". Place your custom map there (it's probably `AppData\Roaming\refunct-tas\maps`). - Once you unlock the Custom minigame and you select it, you will be asked directly which custom map you want to play, you can select it there. You can (re)start whichever you want. - You can make custom maps too with the editor! # Map editor improvements - Pressing `c` and triggering the next cluster should now work better. - You can now press `left`/`right`/`up`/`down`/`pageup`/`pagedown` to work in 3 dimensions without having to toggle. - `TAB` now opens the advanced editor of the selected element, if any.

entry.title: Spyro: A Hero's Tail v2.0.1
entry.content:
# v2.0.1: Fixes & DeathLink Amnesty *Intended for use with game mod version 14.0 or newer (see attachments)*
v2.0.1 of AHT AP contains the following fixes: - Logic was expecting the player to need charge in order to charge underwater. This was a misunderstanding about how the game works: vanilla game does *not* require charge to charge underwater. The game mod has been updated to override this behavior. In other words, going forward, you *will* need to have charge in order to charge underwater, which reflects the current logic of AHT AP for locations and gems. - `hint_minigame_rewards` and `hint_boss_rewards` were inadvertently broken in v2.0.0 due to an overzealous attempt to micro-optimize the client's code. They are back to working again now :)
In addition to those fixes, v2.0.1 also contains 2 things that were slated for v2.1 but due to project organization reasons, are being bundled with v2.0.1: - The game mod now uses a major and minor version in its releases. The client has an improved ability to identify when the detected game mod version is incompatible, compatible but outdated, or compatible. **Please check for messages about compatibility in the client before making any bug reports, as you may simply be using a wrong version.** - New option `death_link_amnesty` allows players to choose how many in-game deaths need to occur before a single DeathLink death is sent out to the multiworld. This option was included in v2.0.1 because it was already created in the v2.1 dev branch, and merging the branches together for v2.0.1 was significantly cleaner in terms of project organization.
[Setup Guide](https://github.com/PhoenixAki/PhoenixAP/wiki/Spyro:-AHT-1-%E2%80%90-Setup-Guide-&-FAQ)

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.9.0
entry.content: ## Changes Most of this release is the bots. ### The run - Mission switch works from the Session tab and from `!mission`. - A refund returns your cash bundles. The plugin counts every credit a bundle adds, and puts that count back on top of the refund. - A lost wave returns the bundles you spent. A balance below zero goes to zero. - The win comes off the locations this server played. Another player's `!collect` checks a mission clear without ending your run. - Bots take their seats as soon as somebody joins the server. They shop at the upgrade station and build before the wave starts. - Bots ready up only after every player on RED is ready. A server with nobody on RED never readies at all. - Bots fill the seat of a player who leaves between waves, and free a seat for a player who arrives. - Test mode answers as a real room does. `!ap unlock mission` hands over the next ticket, `!ap missing` and `!ap checked` reply, and you start on the class you asked for. ### The bots - Bots shoot the Medic first, then the Sniper and the Engineer, then giants. - Ten runs on Decoy measure 25 defender deaths, against 56 for the same waves without the target order. - A bot with nothing to fight holds the hatch. A bot the nav mesh refuses a path steps toward its target. - Every class has upgrade paths, and a bot refuses an upgrade it cannot use. A Phlogistinator Pyro has no use for airblast pushback. - Bots buy blast, bullet and fire resistance against the wave to come. Explosions cause 45 to 60 percent of defender deaths on every map measured. - Leftover credits stay in the wallet. - Engineers build on the spot they picked and rebuild it there, one nest inside and one out, with the teleporter exits apart. - Engineers keep the sentry on its spot through the wave, finish the nest they start, and give up on a spot they cannot reach. - A sentry that cannot reach the nest goes down beside the engineer. The disposable sentry goes beside the real one on purpose. - An engineer with no sentry left rides his own teleporter home. - A map can name which dispenser spot belongs to which nest. - The game walks the Medic, and the mod points the game's own heal action at the biggest body nearby. - On Coal Town the beam connects in 75 percent of samples, and 72 percent of those samples show a Heavy on the end of it. - A Medic deploys six ubers in a mission, and moves 337 units between samples. - Medics shop before they follow anybody, hold the wave until the charge is full, and spread a wave's credits over more than one upgrade. - Soldiers and Demomen keep their distance from a tank hull. - The Demoman rates the stickybomb launcher as no tank weapon, and holds the detonator while his own pipes sit on a hull. - Neither aims at the feet of a robot that stands on them, and the Demoman throws a pipe as far as it flies. - A pipe can leave while the aim still moves, a rocket cannot, which is the difference between the two arcs. - Demomen hold the stickybomb launcher, close to the range their pipes arrive at, and put an empty launcher down in a fight. - The Soldier carries the stock rocket launcher. - The Pyro walks in instead of parking at shotgun range, and bots pick money off the ground. - Each class carries a named loadout and a seat can name its own, so two engineers can hold different weapons. - A bot draws a random cosmetic, and an unusual effect on it, in two ticks, and keeps it for the whole mission. - Bots wear no war paint. It painted the weapons the upgrade station replaces, and killed the server when two engineers finished shopping. - Buildings go on ground that exists, and the wearable sweep ends. - Nav mesh searches for health, ammo and revive markers run less than once a frame. - The plugin builds the shopping list once a session, and hands out hats one bot at a time. - `sm_redbots_feature_` switches any of this off one feature at a time, which is how two ways of playing get compared. ### The window - The run is the first tab and the log is the second. - A mission button names the mission rather than its pop file, and a locked mission says so on the button. - A press says what loads until the server confirms it. - The Bots tab is three pages: Team, Classes and Looks. - Each seat is one line of what it plays and what it holds, and teams save by name. The class pool is two ticks to a line. - The title bar says which build it is, which matters when several carry the same version. - Save leaves a stopped server stopped. Start is the button that starts the server. - Numbers read from the left, columns line up, and no row runs under the scrollbar. - Over Steam the join line reads `Steam public IP:`, and the Join button goes to that address. - The page that issues a login token is a link on the tab that needs one, with app id 440 and a memo. - The terminal launcher follows the window: the run first, the same seats and saved teams, the same Steam address. ### When something goes wrong - Debug logs hold the game server's own console log, the last launcher log and the crash dumps. - They also hold what the bridge says about the run, and which defender bots played. - The plugin writes what it does to the console and the SourceMod log by default. - The plugin writes down every purchase and sale at the upgrade station, players and bots, with the credits held after. - The bots name the upgrade they bought. `mvm_upgrades.txt` has 64 entries and the game loads 63, because one entry carries a comment marker. - A defender bot version bump builds that version, on any machine and in CI. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`.env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/.env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.8.2...v1.9.0 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/N2MyYmM5ZmMxN2I1NjFhNTgzNTAyM2FkNjZiZmI4ZDc6MTc4NzU0ODcyMg==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/NjZmNDMyOTc2Y2QzODU2ZmRlNjgyMTQwZmQzZjVlNjg6MTc4NzU0ODcyNQ==/detection)

entry.title: Pokemon HGSS v0.9.0
entry.content:
**Pokemon HGSS APWorld** It fixes bugs that made seeds unwinnable, and rebuilds the progression logic after checking the region graph systematically against the game's own maps.
**Any seed generated with an earlier version must be regenerated.**
**Read this before updating** Two options are gone and will make generation fail if they are still in a YAML.
- extra_route_blockers existed only to delete one Route 46 to Route 45 connection from the graph. That connection was itself a modeling error, since fixed, so the option no longer did anything. Remove the line.
- lake_of_rage is no longer an available starting town for randomize_start_location. The map has exactly two doors, both on the bank ringed by the water, so a player starting there was stranded without Surf. Pick another town, or set the option to random.
**Critical fixes** - Items could be lost forever when starting a new game. The client could write to save memory before a save file existed. Starting a new game wiped everything it had written, but its own count of delivered items survived that wipe: anything the server had already sent, start_inventory included, was counted as delivered and never sent again. starting_money had the same defect.
- A single bad memory read could send dozens of checks you never made. Reported by a player whose game froze: on reloading, 52 items went out to other players with no way to take them back. Three independent sanity layers now guard every read before a check can be reported.
- DeathLink fired at the start of battles, at random. The fainted-Pokemon counter is stored encrypted in the save file, and re-encrypted every time any statistic changes. The wild-encounter and trainer-battle counters both change exactly when a battle starts, which scrambled the value: roughly half the time the client read it as a death. The counter is now decrypted before being read.
- Found items showed "???" instead of their name. The game has three separate item-name tables and picks between them by sentence construction; only one of the three was being patched.
- Badges no longer unlocked their field moves. Holding a badge only granted its field move once you had also beaten the matching Gym, which made any seed that placed a badge elsewhere unwinnable. Badge and HM are now independent: holding both is enough. This also fixed a permanent block on the Team Rocket takeover storyline, and a cutscene loop.
**Logic overhaul** - The region graph was checked against the game's real maps. The result was severe: the logic believed half of Johto was reachable with nothing at all.
- Twenty-three connections that do not exist were removed. All had the same shape: two places joined both by a gatehouse and by a direct link the map does not have, so the gatehouse could always be walked around. None of them opened anything on their own, but each silently cancelled any requirement placed on the building it bypassed. That is exactly how the Secret Potion, the Ilex Forest Cut check and the Cycling Road Bicycle check ended up doing nothing.
- Eleven passages blocked by a character are now modeled. None of them opens with an item, only with a step of the story: Slowpoke Well after Kurt, the Azalea Gym after Proton, the Team Rocket hideout after Lance at the Lake of Rage, the Mahogany Gym once the hideout is cleared, the Blackthorn Gym after the Radio Tower, the Dragon's Den after Clair, and on the Kanto side the Power Plant, Saffron's underground gatehouses, both Snorlax and the Viridian Gym.
- Key items and badges that gated nothing now do. The Rainbow Wing to climb the Bell Tower, the Fog Badge to approach it, the Silver Wing for Lugia, the Basement Key for the Goldenrod Tunnel, the Card Key for the Radio Tower, the Earth Badge for Cerulean Cave, the Volcano Badge for Route 19, and the Bicycle for Cycling Road.
- Kanto was one key item away from the start of the game. The Olivine sailor checks that the game has been cleared before he even looks at your S.S. Ticket: the ferry does not sail until the Elite Four and the Champion are beaten.
- Three areas were modeled as one place when the terrain splits them in two: Route 46 at its ledge, the Lake of Rage across the water, and the Ice Path, whose exit to Blackthorn sits two floors below and needs Strength.
- Dexsanity could lock a key item behind the very Pokemon that item unlocks. A seed became unwinnable that way: the Squirtbottle was placed on the Tropius check, Tropius only appeared in the Burned Tower, and the Burned Tower is inside Ecruteak, which the Squirtbottle itself opens. Two defects made that invisible. Checks existed for Pokemon never written into the patched ROM at all, and a check's requirements only described the tool needed, never the place. Every check now requires actually reaching somewhere that Pokemon lives.
**New options** - magnet_train (on by default) decides whether the Magnet Train counts for the logic. On, the Pass alone opens the ride and Kanto can be visited early. Off, the ride only counts once you have beaten the Elite Four, so nothing you need can be hidden in Kanto before then.
- balanced, a new mode for randomize_moves. Power and Accuracy are drawn together from weighted tiers instead of independently, so a 200-power move never comes with coin-flip accuracy. Accuracy never drops below 75.
**Behaviour change** - randomize_start_location no longer touches your front door. The option rewired your house door to lead into Elm's Lab, and that shortcut was permanent: players who came home much later found their own front door still leading into the lab. The opening is vanilla from start to finish again.
**State of this release** All the logic is covered by a test suite exercised against both real ROMs. Emulator validation is another matter and remains partial: the eleven story locks are correct at source level, checked line by line against the decompilation, but *not all of them have been observed in game.*
Bug reports are welcome, especially on those locks and on seeds using randomize_start_location.

entry.title: Nine Sols v0.6.3
entry.content:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/NineSolsArchipelagoRandomizer?tab=readme-ov-file#installation).
- Fixed UT map page auto-tabbing to/from the world_map when the Teleport menu is opened or closed. Hopefully for real this time. - Fixed the pause menu seal count displays so they should be legible at any window size. - Jade Cost Plando is now an OptionCounter, so it can be edited in the Options Creator - Fixed a shop rando corner case where the forced DS/HC purchase logic would ask you to buy a !collected item, which was also disabled. - AP hint generation is now done in batches. For example, if you open Kuafu's shop and there are 5 useful/prog items, the mod will (usually) send only 1 message to the AP server with all 5 locations to hint, instead of 5 separate messages. - The source of truth for Nine Sols' logic has been moved from .jsonc to .py files in order to improve the process around contributing logic changes. This should be an invisible internal change, but it's worth mentioning in case there are bugs, or you liked inspecting these files. ----- - `vanilla` logic: - "OW - Activate Crates And Return" is now reachable with Cloud Leap replacing Nymph, because the crushers you're expected to disable with nymph can instead be bypassed by using Cloud Leap and Air Dash to spend several seconds over the red floor - `medium` logic: - "AM - Above Root Node" to "Bottom Right" now allows Wall Climb and T-dash - "AF (Depths) - Lower Level" to "Under Lower Left Exit" was incorrectly in logic with only Swift Runner; now it requires Grapple and Swift Runner - "AF (Elevator) - Moving Boxes Below Root Node" to "Statue Chest" now allows Swift Runner and T-dash - "CTH - Yanren Arena" is now reachable with neither Nymph nor Cloud Leap, by using (Wall Climb + Air Dash + Tai-Chi Kick + (Swift Runner OR Charged Strike)) to platform all the way through the tunnel and grab the side of the stationary crate - "OW - Activate Crates And Return" is now reachable with bow hover for the same reason as the `vanilla` change - "OW - Outside Enemy Gauntlet Room" is now reachable by using bow hover to avoid the crusher then get back onto the same crate it just crushed - "OW: Crusher Gauntlet" is now reachable using Wall Climb, Ledge Grab, and either Charged Strike or (bow hover and Swift Runner) - `ledge_storage` logic: - "ED (Passages) - Statue In Left Chasm" is now reachable with parry hover from left pink pool, which requires CL and AD since the only available ledge uses CL setup and it's on the other side of the pink waterfall you need AD to pass through - "GoS (West): Above Elevator" was incorrectly in logic with only Ledge Grab. Now it's Ledge Grab and Air Dash. - "GoS (West) - Lower Right Exits" to "Lower Platform Rotation Button" with CL + LG triple jump is now in logic - "GoS (West) - Lower Right Exits" to "Cixing Arena Left Overlook" now requires only LG instead of CL+LG, because you can do T-dash setup on the right side of the elevator chasm - "OW - Activate Crates And Return" is now reachable with parry hover for the same reason as the `vanilla` change - "OW - Lower Right Exit" to "Root Node & Middle Exits" is now reachable without Wall Climb. You could already use Cloud Leap and Ledge Grab to *activate* the lower crates, but we realized CL and LG also lets you jump from the activated crates to the root node without Wall Climb. - "OW - Outside Enemy Gauntlet Room" is now reachable by using parry hover to avoid the crusher then get back onto the same crate it just crushed

entry.title: Factorio: Space Age v3.0.0
entry.content:
# Factorio: Space Age apworld 3.0.0
* Added `map_exchange_string` YAML option to allow arbitrarily customizable world generation settings. [#38](https://github.com/thejoshwolfe/Archipelago/issues/38) * Thanks to Rseding91 [here](https://forums.factorio.com/viewtopic.php?t=132784) and rfvgyhn [here](https://github.com/rfvgyhn/factorio-exchange-string-parser) for providing the support needed to make this happen. * This apworld is now version locked with specifically Factorio 2.1.14. This is because during the public beta experimental phase, Factorio is breaking the map exchange string format without warning. Once Factorio 2.1 is stable, the version locking can be relaxed. * (BREAKING) The `world_gen_custom` option is gone. Nobody (including me) knew how to use it properly; good riddance. The `world_gen_asteroid_spawn_rate` and `world_gen_spoil_rate` placeholder options are also gone. Use `map_exchange_string` instead. * The `world_gen` option is overhauled: * `custom` now uses `map_exchange_string` instead of `world_gen_custom`, but still respects `world_gen_enemies` and randomizes the seed. * `custom_verbatim` (new) uses `map_exchange_string` and makes no modifications. * `vanilla` is renamed to `default` so that it exactly matches the in-game name for the preset. `vanilla` is still accepted as an alias. (and confusingly `default` is not the default. The default is still `buffed_resources`.) * `rail_world`, `death_world`, `ribbon_world`, etc. are all added to represent the builtin presets. [#7](https://github.com/thejoshwolfe/Archipelago/issues/7) * The temporary save file in the Client's cwd has been renamed from `Archipelago.zip` to `ArchipelagoTemporaryServerQuery.zip` to make it clear that that's not the save file that you actually play on, and it's ok to delete it whenever you want. (Today I learned that it was not the save file you actually play on; perhaps others will now also know.) If you launch the client through the UI, then this file is probably in your Archipelago directory.

entry.title: Stardew Valley v8.1.2

entry.title: Wikipelago v1.0.0
entry.content:
## Wikipelago 1.0.0
A custom Archipelago world inspired by wiki racing. Each check is a **Start → Target** round: click Wikipedia links to reach the target, collect items, and finish the **Grand Goal**.
Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7**. Web client: https://wikipelago.dreskn.fr/
Install `wikipelago.apworld` and this YAML from the assets below, then generate a **new** seed.
### How it plays - Only in-article Wikipedia links count as moves - Some rounds are open at the start; **Round Access** unlocks more - Collect **Knowledge Fragments** to reveal the Grand Goal, a question with the answer being your final goal page. Reach it to finish the slot.
### Languages Play on **English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, or Polish** Wikipedia (`wikipedia_language` in the YAML). The top-right dropdown only translates the client UI; it does not change which wiki you race on.
### Defaults and extras - **Side branches** can be unlocked by reaching a crossroad and obtaining a key. They are themed target pages that you can reach simultaneously as progressing the main road. - **Letter-pair bingo** adds boards filled with letter pais. Visit pages starting with these paris to stamp your board. Full lines count as location checks. Stamps can be found to check a nasty letter pair! - Tools: **Back**, **Reroll**, **Search**, **Compass** can help you navigate the game, can be unlocked from the start or through the pool. - Optional spice (off by default): deaths and deathlink, traps and traplink, sanities, hiding parts of wiki pages, Use at your own risk.
### Docs [Overview](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/overview.md) · [Setup](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/setup.md) · [Options](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/options.md) · [FAQ](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/faq.md)
### Older rooms The hosted client is 1.0 after this release. Old seeds should continue to work on the new client, but to stay on the old 0.6 client, run locally from tag [`0.6.0-ZaWarudo!`](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/releases/tag/v0.6.0-ZaWarudo!), see [Setup, Option 2](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/setup.md#option-2--local-client-private--vpn-rooms).

entry.title: One Must Fall: 2097 v0.0.5
entry.content:
# Archipelago OpenOMF v0.0.5
> OMF:2097 was released as freeware by Epic MegaGames in 1999. The game data is freely and legally downloadable.
---
### What's New
#### Fixes (Multiworld)
- Fixed shop purchases not being remembered when the location's item belongs to another game in the multiworld. Shop state was previously rebuilt from `ReceivedItems`, which only fires for items sent back to *us* — a location whose item goes to another player never echoes back, so the shop showed it as never bought and charged you for it again every time you reopened the mechlab. Shop state is now derived from the server's `checked_locations` instead, which reflects every location *we've* checked regardless of who receives the item - As part of the same fix, shop/training state now also picks up: locations found while disconnected (synced on the next connect), server-side auto-releases (e.g. another game completing and releasing all its remaining checks), and checks made by another client connected to the same slot in co-op - Fixed the shop being able to skip past a still-unbought level if a later level in the same stat got checked out of order (same-slot co-op, a release) — it now keeps offering the actual next unbought level, and instantly recognizes the skipped one as owned once you reach it - Fixed the shop/training price label staying one step behind after a purchase until you moved focus away and back — it now updates immediately ---
### Links
- [Setup guide](https://github.com/stubobis1/archipelago-openomf-apworld/blob/master/worlds/openomf/docs/setup_en.md) - [Game guide](https://github.com/stubobis1/archipelago-openomf-apworld/blob/master/worlds/openomf/docs/en_One%20Must%20Fall%202097.md) - [Parent repo](https://github.com/stubobis1/archipelago-openomf) - [Client repo](https://github.com/stubobis1/openomf) - [AP world repo](https://github.com/stubobis1/archipelago-openomf-apworld) - [Issues](https://github.com/stubobis1/archipelago-openomf/issues)

Alpha 4 combines the current correction build with the upstream native renderer and retail-parity sync so the full candidate can be tested together. This is a prerelease, not stable 0.2.0.

entry.title: Crypt of the NecroDancer v0.8.0
entry.content:
### Notes - **This update requires AP Redux mod v4.0.0 or newer**. The apworld and the mod changed significantly this release, and older mod versions will refuse to connect. The same applies in reverse - **In-progress multiworlds cannot be carried over to v0.8.0**. This update adds a variety of new locations types and reshapes the item pool. Finish your existing worlds before updating.
### Changes - Refactored practically the entire APWorld logic (generation, items, locations, regions) to abide by recommendations provided by the community, APQuest's implementation specifically. - I'm 99% certain generation is working as intended, but please reach out if something seems out of order! - Add option to include shrines as checks. - Enabling this adds all available shrines to the item pool depending on enabled DLC. A shrine that has not been acquired yet will not generate mid-run. Upon first activation of the shrine, the check will be sent to the client. A shrine no character in your pool could ever trigger will not be included (Aria cannot access Shrine of Pain, for instance). - Add option to set how many items found mid-run will be considered as checks per zone. Default is 8, but can be increased to 25. - Item generation chance (default 25%) makes a 25% chance for items generated on level load to instead be these per-zone item checks. Items can be found spawned in secret rooms, (non-flawless) chests, crates, barrels, and shops currently. - Add option to include flawless boss chests as checks per zone. - Add option to set how many rows of AP Lobby shop locations will generate in the multiworld. Default is 4, but can be increased to 25. - Setting this value to -1 (or "auto") will leave the shop rows as-is: 8 rows without DLC enabled, 12 rows with all DLC enabled. - Add option to set how many progress locations exist per zone. Default is 2 (Floor 2 + Zone completion), but can be increased to 4 (Floors 1, 2, 3, and Zone completion). - Personally, I'm a bit on the fence regarding this change; you're still required to go through the whole zone for all checks, so it feels like there's little benefit for this change aside from reducing location amounts in the multiworld. Considering changing this to not always include the Zone completion, which should alleviate having to play through the entirety of each zone as each character in the pool. - Add option to set speedrun time limits for getting All Zones location checks. Configurable for each character, default is 0 (disabled), but can be increased to 60 minutes per character. - Any values set less than 3 minutes are increased to 3 minutes minimum. - Add diamond exchange rate option to determine how many diamonds are received on successful run completion. Default is 100 gold per diamond, but can be either reduced to 0 (disabled) or 1000. - Add option to handle DeathLinks when playing multiplayer: does each player dying send a DeathLink packet or only when all players die? Default is the latter. - Add +1 Red/Black/Purple Chest Per Zone and Progressive Gold Multiplier items. - Add 12 new filler items to the item pool: "Bomb", "3 Bombs", "Grenade", "Spare Potion", "Spare Coupon", "Spare Heart Transplant", "Answered Need", "Depth Skip", "Random Item", "Random Shrine", "Charmed Escort", "Fire Sale" - Spare items spawn that item for the player but does not unlock it for generation mid-run. Answered Need and Depth Skip spawn a Scroll of Need and a Depth Scroll respectively. - Random Item spawns any chest pool item, regardless of unlock. Random Shrine spawns any acquired shrine around the player. - Charmed Escort spawns 3 random charmed enemies around the player(s). These can be minibosses and shopkeepers. - Fire Sale makes all shops on the current floor 50% off. - Add 4 new traps to the item pool: - Frank Trap (Amplified Required): Frankensteinway spawns in the level, similarly to Dead Ringer Trap - Freddy Trap: Summons a passive Shopkeeper around each player - Wall Pig Trap: Replaces tiles with a vacant left or right tile throughout the level 7% of the time with a Wall Pig facing in that respective direction. A minimum of 5 Wall Pigs will spawn regardless. - Trap Trap: Replaces vacant floor tiles throughout the level at a 10% chance with traps, more weighted towards spike and confusion traps. - Adjusted starting inventory logic to always give items related to disabled settings (Materials, Progressive Access Keys, Character Room Key, Shrines) - Modified location growth to be interchangeable between per zone item checks (if greater than 0) and shop item checks (if greater than 0). If locations are still needed, then shop rows will grow regardless of their setting. - Supply item room item categories and associated items over to the mod from the client. - Fix character item requirements being tracked separately by the apworld and the mod. The client now supplies the mod all of the character item requirements.
Please see the [setup file](https://github.com/lastingParadox/Archipelago-CotND/blob/crypt-of-the-necrodancer/worlds/cotnd/docs/setup_en.md) for getting started.
Please inform me of any issues through the associated [Crypt of the NecroDancer channel in the Archipelago Discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1192775219740422176) or through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/lastingParadox/Archipelago-CotND/issues).

# Drehmal Archipelago v0.3.0
## Bugfixes: - Made tower unlock rewards thread safe - Now batch sends location check packets to Archipelago server - Implemented a more reliable fix for advancement rewards glitch - Prevented teleport trap's effect from sending players out of bounds - Fixed various typos - Fixed Aphelion deathlooping
## Improvements: - Added randomized starting location - Two new completion goals: - Added completion goal for reaching Drehmal's end credits room - Added completion goal for reaching a certain Terminus unlock percentage - Added music randomizer option for Drehmal's custom soundtrack - Logic overhaul for vanilla and vanilla-like advancements - Moved Foundry to the Veldt for balancing purposes - Buffed the teleport trap substantially
## Setup:
### Required software:
- [Drehmal APOTHEOSIS v2.2.2f for Minecraft Fabric 1.20.1](https://www.drehmal.net/downloads) - Additional mods: - Drehmal Archipelago Mod v0.3.0 - [Koala Lib v1.2.14](https://modrinth.com/mod/koala_lib/version/1.2.14) - [Unsafe World Random Access Detector v1.1.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/uwrad/version/1.1.0) - The hi_drehmal_rando datapack v0.3.0
### Joining a Multiworld
1. Install Drehmal v2.2.2f and its corresponding modpack (Note that Drehmal provides a custom installer, available on its downloads page, if you don't want to manually create the Fabric installation) 2. Add the three additional mods listed above to the mods folder of Drehmal's Minecraft installation 3. Go into the save file you're going to be playing on and replace the hi_drehmal.zip datapack with the hi_drehmal_rando.zip datapack at path [Fabric install]/saves/Drehmal APOTHEOSIS 2.2.2f/datapacks/hi_drehmal_rando.zip 4. Launch Minecraft and enter the Drehmal world 5. In the lobby room, before activating the first terminal, run the command /archipelago connect "[server name]:[port]" [player name] 6. Have fun!
### Rejoining an earlier game
On reconnect, if your connection info hasn't changed, the mod should automatically reconnect you to the Archipelago server. Otherwise, run /archipelago disconnect and then run the connect command again with the new information.

entry.title: Crash Team Racing v0.2.0a5
entry.content:
# CTR Archipelago 0.2.0 Alpha 5
Alpha 5 is a focused correctness and graphics prerelease. The client and `ctr.apworld` are a matched pair, so install the apworld included in your platform archive before generating a seed and keep every player in the room on Alpha 5.
For the complete player-facing 0.2.0 changelog, see the [0.2.0 release notes on Archipelago Pie](https://ap-pie.com/ctr/reference/0-2-0-release-notes).
## Highlights
- Render Scale can now be set to Original, 2X, 3X, 4X or Native. - Smooth Scaling and Texture Filtering are now player-facing options. - Blue Fire U-turns work while reserves are active. - Fixed Oxide's garage opening and the Final Challenge appearing before all configured goal requirements were complete. - Shuffled warp-pad access is repaired for seeds that do not require four Keys. - Gem Cup AP boxes now follow the physical warp-pad access of each cup leg.
The complete combined candidate passed focused automated tests, fresh Linux AP and vanilla builds, a fresh Windows build, and an integrated Steam runtime pass. Text remains at the original UI resolution and can look soft at 4X or Native; higher-resolution text is future work rather than part of this release.
See `README-ALPHA5.md` and `KNOWN-ISSUES.md` inside the archive for exact source identities, hashes, setup notes and the current attention list. CTR-AP does not ship Crash Team Racing game data.

entry.title: AEMinecraft v0.5.1
entry.content:
## AEMinecraft v0.5.1
A maintenance release: one generation failure fixed, and a round of corrections to the logic that decides when a check is reachable.
### Fixed
**Generation failed with BlazeandCave's Advancements Pack and `challenge_sanity: all`.** Any seed combining those two options crashed during generation and produced no output. The cause was a loop in the logic for BACAP's "Super Challenges" tab. These seeds now generate normally. Other `challenge_sanity` settings were never affected.
### Improved
**Sixteen checks no longer come for free.** Each of them could previously be completed without owning anything the randomizer had placed, which let progression open up earlier than intended. They now ask for what the game actually requires — among them:
- items that can only be collected with **shears** or **Silk Touch**, such as glow lichen, dead bushes, grass, ferns, vines and mushroom blocks - **nether wart**, which only grows inside Nether Fortresses and Bastion Remnants, and previously opened the entire brewing tree on arrival in the Nether - **wither roses**, which require defeating the Wither - **string** from cobwebs, and **carved pumpkins**
Tool requirements are now read directly from the game files, so they stay correct as Minecraft changes.
### Upgrading
- The mod and the apworld are released together and should be used as a matched set. - Seeds generated with v0.5.0 are unaffected and can be finished as they are. - Because the logic is stricter, regenerating an existing v0.5.0 seed with v0.5.1 will produce a different placement. Generate a new seed rather than expecting the old one to be reproduced. - No YAML changes are required.

entry.title: New Super Mario Bros. DS v0.4.5a0
entry.content:
This update adds more customization for the emulator feed, two new traps, and an option to randomize the in-level secondary-screen backgrounds. It also includes several fixes for mislabeled locations, Secret Exit handling, and logic requirements.
### Added
* Added a fade-out effect to the emulator feed * Added emulator feed settings to the client that apply immediately and are saved automatically: * On/Off * Width * Position * Fade-out duration * Added the Power-Up Pickpocket Trap, which removes your stored reserve Power-Up * Added the No Turnaround Trap, which temporarily prevents Mario from changing direction backwards * Added an in-level secondary-screen background randomizer
### Fixed
* Fixed World 8-8 and World 8-Tower 2 being mislabeled * Fixed World 7-6 and World 7-Castle being mislabeled * Fixed the World 4-1 Secret Exit not being sent after completion when the Tower Key had not been received * Fixed Secret Exit shortcuts being required for progression when secret_exit_shortcut_logic was disabled * Fixed mixed-up requirements for the World 8 Toad Houses * Removed the Large Mario requirement from World 3-1 Star Coin 3
